status: one-seed z-only reinjection diagnostic; not a headline result
interpretation: Naive all-layer additive reinjection does not improve the current z-only strong-goal baseline on this one-seed held-out pilot.
Task exact match and facet satisfaction both decrease relative to input-only conditioning.
Correct-versus-shuffled and zero-goal causal effects also decrease, so repeated access alone is not sufficient under this additive mechanism.
This points toward either a more selective reinjection schedule such as periodic or late-layer access, or a different conditioning mechanism such as prefix-style or KV-based control.
